description: Trading-engine patch guardrails; review and trust through Codex /hooks.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; cwd=Path.cwd(); root=next(p for p in (cwd,*cwd.parents) if (p/'.git').exists()); sys.argv=[str(root/'scripts/codex_guardrails.py'),'hook']; runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
hooks.commandWindows: python -c "import runpy,subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; root=Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip()); sys.argv=[str(root/'scripts/codex_guardrails.py'),'hook']; runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
